caption:
Phones, emails, typing. Momo sits at the front desk in one position all day, and her shoulders feel like rocks.

Staying in one position for long stretches can tire muscles quickly. Remedial massage can help tight shoulders feel easier, and it tends to work well alongside moving more often.

Hybi's desk reset: take calls on a headset or speaker, roll your shoulders back 10 times, stand and walk about every 30 minutes, and side neck stretch 20 seconds each side.

Frequent headaches or arm tingling are worth an assessment first. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
